title: A 3GPP-Compliant Benchmark Dataset for RIS-Aided Beyond 5G Networks
abstract: arXiv:2609.39058v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces (RIS) are emerging as a key technology for programmable wireless environments in the beyond the fifth generation (B5G) networks. However, data-driven RIS research remains bottleneck by the lack of standardized, high-fidelity and open-source datasets. In this paper, we introduce a large-scale 3GPP TR 38.901-compliant dataset for RIS-aided millimeter wave (mmWave) networks, that considers severe path loss, blockage sensitivity, and spatial channel sparsity make the RIS assistance more impactful. The dataset spans various canonical 3GPP deployment scenarios across 20 controlled variants, capturing diverse user densities, fading conditions, and blockage regimes. Uniquely, every sample includes oracle RIS phase configurations obtained via a globally optimal brute-force codebook search, providing gold-standard supervision labels that are absent from any existing public dataset. Rich multi-task annotations

translated_title: 一个面向RIS辅助的5G及后续网络的3GPP兼容基准数据集
translated_abstract: 可重构智能表面（RIS）正在成为5G及后续（B5G）网络中构建可编程无线环境的关键技术。然而，由于缺乏标准化、高保真度且开源的数据集，数据驱动的RIS研究一直受到瓶颈制约。本文介绍了一个面向RIS辅助毫米波（mmWave）网络的大规模、符合3GPP TR 38.901标准的数据集，该数据集充分考虑了严重的路径损耗、对遮挡的敏感性以及空间信道的稀疏性使得RIS辅助的作用更为显著。该数据集覆盖了多种典型的3GPP部署场景，共包含20种受控变体，捕获了多样的用户密度、衰落条件和遮挡情况。独特之处在于，每个样本都包含通过全局最优的暴力码本搜索获得的“神谕”RIS相位配置，提供了任何现有公开数据集中都不具备的金标准监督标签。丰富的多任务标注……
tldr: 该论文发布了一个符合3GPP TR 38.901标准的大规模开源RIS辅助毫米波基准数据集，其独特之处在于包含通过全局最优暴力搜索获得的RIS相位配置金标准标签，填补了数据驱动RIS研究缺乏高质量公开数据集的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a large-scale 3GPP TR 38.901-compliant benchmark dataset for RIS-aided mmWave networks, uniquely featuring oracle RIS phase configurations obtained via globally optimal brute-force search as gold-standard supervision labels, filling the gap of high-quality open datasets for data-driven RIS research.
